user_request: 我觉得如果跑到100条，你发现ttft和tpot都还是规则内的，就可以终止，往上加了
scope: Subsequent SLA points in existing live search; current 0.25 RPS point remains 200 because its executor is already loaded
early_check: First 100 scheduled requests all completed successfully; both mean latency limits met; cache within tolerance and offered rate valid
if_check_passes: Cancel only not-yet-submitted requests, drain all in-flight requests and include all submitted results in final point verdict and revenue
if_check_fails: Continue to 200 with original open-loop schedule
report: Actual sample count, planned maximum, early-stop decision and final post-drain verdict; do not claim all points have 200 samples
